title: CWC Flood Forecast Station River Water Levels — Assam Revenue Circles (Monthly)
description: Monthly river water level statistics (mean, min, max) per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from Central Water Commission Flood Forecast Station gauge readings, used as a hazard input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Input covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model, capturing river stage as a fluvial flood hazard driver.
details: License terms for redistributing CWC FFS gauge data have not been confirmed — treat 'license' as a placeholder. Temporal coverage reflects Sources/master/riverlevel.csv (2016-01 to 2024-05). Stations are grouped in three CWC divisions: Upper Brahmaputra (Dibrugarh), Middle Brahmaputra (Guwahati), Lower Brahmaputra (Jalpaiguri).
